overview.pattern: Cache-first agentic loop with a modular tool registry
overview.description: Reasonix-legacy is a DeepSeek-native coding agent. The core abstraction is CacheFirstLoop (src/loop.ts), which drives turns by streaming model completions, dispatching tool calls through a ToolRegistry, healing/scavenging malformed tool output (src/repair), shrinking oversized context (src/loop/shrink.ts), and persisting a transcript. The model is accessed exclusively through DeepSeekClient (src/client.ts), and the loop is decoupled from concrete tool/memory/hook implementations via the src/ports interfaces.

data-flow.flow: CLI argv -> resolveDefaults -> chatCommand/runCommand -> CacheFirstLoop -> DeepSeekClient(stream) -> tool dispatch -> tool results -> context shrink -> next turn -> transcript log
data-flow.description: User input enters via the TUI (chat) or one-shot (run/acp/desktop). The loop accumulates messages in a ContextManager; on each turn it streams a DeepSeek completion, parses tool calls, dispatches them chunked (loop/dispatch.ts), appends results (possibly truncated/saved-to-disk by tools/truncated-result-saver), and continues until the model stops emitting tool calls. A transcript is written incrementally (transcript/log.ts).

ports-and-adapters.description: src/ports/ defines abstract interfaces (model-client, tool-host, event-sink, hook-runner, memory-store, checkpoint-store); src/adapters/ provides concrete JSONL implementations. DeepSeekClient and ToolRegistry are the default adapters wired by chatCommand. This lets ACP/desktop/runtime swap implementations without touching the loop.

tui-runtime.pattern: Custom Ink fork (React reconciler -> Yoga -> terminal)
tui-runtime.description: A forked Ink runtime lives at packages/ink (path-aliased as 'ink' in tsconfig.json). It renders React 19 components via react-reconciler + yoga-layout into a diff-based terminal screen. The chat TUI (src/cli/ui/App.tsx and ~50 supporting components) is the primary UX; the dashboard is a separate Vite-built web app served by an HTTP server.

conventions.naming: kebab-case filenames, camelCase identifiers, PascalCase types/components. CLI subcommands are verbs (run/chat/commit/stats).
conventions.file-organization: src/ is grouped by subsystem (loop, tools, mcp, repair, memory, transcript, telemetry, code, code-query, index/semantic, cli, server, acp, qq/telegram/weixin, desktop). Each tool registers itself via a registerXTools() function. Barrel exports in src/index.ts expose the public library API.
conventions.imports: ESM throughout (type: module). Relative .js specifiers even between .ts files (NodeNext-style). Path aliases: '@/*' -> src/*, 'ink' -> packages/ink/src/index.ts.
conventions.error-style: Loop errors are classified in src/loop/errors.ts (4xx/5xx/host-reachability); unexpected throws in API handlers map to HTTP 500 with a structured envelope.
conventions.testing: Vitest unit tests in tests/, mutation testing via Stryker, dashboard tests via jsdom + @testing-library/react + ink-testing-library.

build.pattern: tsup ESM bundles + Vite dashboard + Tauri desktop
build.description: tsup produces two ESM bundles: a library (src/index.ts -> dist/index.js, with dts) and a CLI (src/cli/index.ts -> dist/cli/index.js, noExternal:[/.*/] with a require-shim banner). The dashboard is built by Vite (npm run build:dashboard). Post-build scripts copy vendor CSS and tree-sitter grammars. The desktop app wraps the dashboard in a Tauri (Rust) shell.

security.pattern: Loopback-bound dashboard with token CSRF; tool allow-lists; redaction
security.description: The dashboard HTTP server defaults to 127.0.0.1 with a per-boot 32-byte token; all mutations require the token header. LAN bind (0.0.0.0) is allowed but warned. Shell tools enforce an allow-list (isAllowed) and require confirmation (ShellConfirm). Event redaction strips secrets before emission (src/core/event-redaction.ts). API keys are read from env/config and never logged.

repair-pipeline.description: Models occasionally emit malformed/truncated tool calls. src/repair implements scavenge (recover tool calls from free text), truncation repair (close truncated JSON), schema flatten/nest (coerce args to the declared JSON schema), and StormBreaker (halt runaway tool-call storms). This is exposed as ToolCallRepair and applied inside the loop's healing step (src/loop/healing.ts).

mcp-integration.pattern: Pluggable MCP transports bridged into the ToolRegistry
mcp-integration.description: src/mcp implements a JSON-RPC client over three transports (stdio, sse, streamable-http). bridgeMcpTools() adapts remote MCP tools into local ToolDefinitions with result flattening and per-token truncation (truncateForModelByTokens). An interactive marketplace browser (mcp-browse) and inspector (mcp-inspect) aid discovery.

memory-tiers.pattern: Immutable prefix + append-only log + volatile scratch; project/user/session scopes
memory-tiers.description: Runtime memory (src/memory/runtime.ts) splits the system prompt into ImmutablePrefix (cache-friendly), AppendOnlyLog, and VolatileScratch. Project memory (PROJECT_MEMORY_FILE), user MemoryStore, and per-session logs (src/memory/session.ts) are layered via applyMemoryStack when the system prompt is rebuilt.

context-management.description: ContextManager (src/context-manager.ts) tracks token usage and folds old turns past TURN_START_FOLD_THRESHOLD. src/loop/shrink.ts shrinks oversized tool-call args and tool results (by chars or tokens). src/loop/reasoning-retention.ts strips droppable reasoning content across turns to preserve cache prefix stability.

semantic-index.pattern: Optional local vector index over the workspace
semantic-index.description: src/index/semantic builds an embedding index (chunker + embedding provider, Ollama supported via ollama-launcher). The semantic tool (tool.ts) and /api/semantic endpoint expose code-aware retrieval. Configured via src/index/config.ts and gated by semanticPreflight.

remote-channels.pattern: Optional chat bots (QQ, Telegram, WeChat) wired as channels
remote-channels.description: src/qq, src/telegram, src/weixin each implement a Bot (EventEmitter) + channel + access control + use-*Channel hook. They forward messages into the loop and route replies back, allowing the agent to be driven from messaging platforms.

component:DeepSeekClient.responsibility: DeepSeek API HTTP client: chat completions (stream + non-stream), usage accounting, model list, balance.

component:CacheFirstLoop.responsibility: Main agent loop: turn iteration, tool dispatch, healing, shrink, hook events, transcript writes.

component:ToolRegistry.responsibility: Registers ToolDefinitions; supports interceptors, result augmenters, audit listeners, allow-lists.

component:ContextManager.responsibility: Tracks token usage and folds old messages past threshold.

component:ToolCallRepair.responsibility: Scavenge, truncation repair, schema flatten/nest, storm-breaking.

component:DashboardServer.responsibility: HTTP dashboard server (loopback default, token auth, optional LAN).

component:InkRuntime.responsibility: Forked Ink TUI runtime (React reconciler + Yoga + terminal renderer).

component:ChatTUI.responsibility: Interactive chat TUI app (Ink React tree).

component:SemanticIndex.responsibility: Builds and queries an embedding index over the workspace.

component:ACP.responsibility: Agent Client Protocol stdio JSON-RPC server.

component:Hooks.responsibility: Loads + runs configured shell hooks on tool events.
